verdict.rationale: Docs confirm schedules support overrides directly (rotations, layers, overrides, restrictions, previews) without needing a rebuild, which addresses the 'take an override' part of the story. However, there is no evidence of self-service shift-swap or coverage-request workflows for individual on-call engineers. missing for 10: explicit shift-swap capability, coverage-request workflow, and confirmation that engineers (not admins) can perform these actions directly.
